result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. The `cli` module compiles and its existing tests pass. I did not run the command itself, so I haven't seen `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` or `index.html` get created, and I added no tests.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` before `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: Dispatch accepts either name and calls the same `updateLandscape(args)` method. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name you typed.
- **`README.md`**: It had no command descriptions and never mentioned `updateLandscape`, so I added a short "Commands" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape` and notes that `updateLandscape` is the same command, kept so existing scripts keep working.
